summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of the Third Tranche of its share buyback program (Program Scheme 1), having reached the maximum monetary amount of €1,460 million. The tranche acquired 70,339,213 shares (~1.26% of share capital), with final transactions between July 27 and August 3, 2026, averaging ~€23.5 per share. Shares were bought through Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG as manager. The buyback's purpose is capital reduction via share redemption, expected to follow. This is a routine buyback completion notice, not a distinct special-situation event.
